title: Change Pilot Output
description: Output contract for the change-pilot skill. customer_output is always returned; analysis is only included in debug mode.

customer_output.description: The customer-facing result. The only block intended for end-user consumption.

title.description: Short title of the change. Null for trivial single-sentence changes.

description.description: Customer-facing description, 1-2 sentences, professional and concise.

analysis.description: Internal analysis block, only emitted in debug mode. Not for end users.

change_types.description: Recognized change types from the controlled vocabulary.

business_intent.description: One-sentence business purpose of the change.

business_facts.description: Business facts that pass through to the customer output.

technical_details.description: Technical implementation details that were hidden or abstracted.

hidden_details.description: Internal identifiers, file paths, IDs that were hidden.

abstractions.description: Mapping from technical source to business target.

validation.description: Self-check flags from the validate stage. Always present.
